reason: Normalize the stable recovery deliverables without claiming future interface approval or implementation.

values: Implement only adl-runtime/src/distributed/recovery.rs and adl-runtime/tests/distributed_recovery.rs; integration issue #5878 owns production module registration

Provide deterministic focused recovery tests covering every migration stage, restart, source and target loss, quorum loss, divergent durable histories, stale or malicious authority claims, and bounded-resource denial
Provide exact-revision execution proof with machine-derived negative-case evidence and immutable source/evidence bindings
Obtain independent exact-head security and correctness review before publication and retain a bounded rollback path
Fail closed whenever recovery authority is ambiguous: neither the highest local epoch nor the last durable local owner may confer authority without majority or quorum committed proof
